response.rationale: Erdheim-Chester disease is strongly associated with bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses, which are explicitly mentioned in the vignette. The other candidates (Polyarteritis nodosa, Takayasu arteritis) also have these masses as support, but Erdheim-Chester disease is more specifically known for these findings.
